description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing OAuth client webhooks, including creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting webhooks. It uses various decorators for routing, guards for security, and DTOs for data transfer.

classes.name: OAuthClientWebhooksController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling OAuth client webhook operations such as create, update, retrieve, and delete.

methods.name: createOAuthClientWebhook
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth client webhook using provided data.

methods.name: updateOAuthClientWebhook
methods.description: Updates an existing webhook identified by webhookId.

methods.name: getOAuthClientWebhook
methods.description: Retrieves a specific webhook by webhookId.

methods.name: getOAuthClientWebhooks
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of webhooks for a specific OAuth client.

methods.name: deleteOAuthClientWebhook
methods.description: Deletes a specific webhook identified by webhook.

methods.name: deleteAllOAuthClientWebhooks
methods.description: Deletes all webhooks for a specific OAuth client.
